changelog:
Stablecoin Depeg Monitor v1.0.1

- Monitors USDT, USDC, DAI, FRAX, and other major stablecoins for depeg events in real time.
- Tracks prices across both on-chain DEXes (Curve, Uniswap) and CEXes (Binance, Coinbase).
- Detects peg deviations, stress signals, bank run risk, and arbitrage opportunities.
- Provides analytics on peg recovery velocity, liquidity depth, and depeg history.
- Useful for traders, DeFi protocols, treasury operators, and risk managers seeking fast insight into stablecoin health.
